comment: The foundational identity API example assumes retrieval of a verified national identifier. This can increase exclusion, surveillance and cross-domain linkage risk, and couples health services to an identity system whose coverage or trust may be incomplete. Health services and public-health reporting must be able to proceed when identity is absent, contested or unsafe to disclose.

public.text: The foundational identity API example assumes retrieval of a verified national identifier. This can increase exclusion, surveillance and cross-domain linkage risk, and couples health services to an identity system whose coverage or trust may be incomplete. Health services and public-health reporting must be able to proceed when identity is absent, contested or unsafe to disclose.
public.suggestedRevision: Require sector-specific or pseudonymous tokens where suitable, data minimization, purpose-bound matching, separation of identifiers, audit and redress. Define temporary/unknown-person workflows and state explicitly that essential care or reporting must not be denied or delayed because a foundational identifier cannot be verified.
